text:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for chart: gateway-worker v2.3.0 -> v3.0.0. Reason: values checksum changed and CRD version bump detected (v1alpha1 -> v1beta1). Auto-promotion locked.

mina: CRD migration in chart v3.0.0 will change status field shape. QA ran against v3.0.0 in staging but we didn't vet migrations in prod.

oscar: if we promote now, some older tenants might fail reconciliation. Options: pin chart to v2.3.1 (hotfix), proceed with migration and run a migration-job, or manual rollback path.

tara: rollout window is tight (change window closes in 20m). We need a quick decision. Is migration reversible?

platform-eng: migration is one-way for current controller; we can add a pre-migration job to translate CRs, but that takes ~40m. Not doable inside the window.

mina: lean conservative: fallback to v2.3.1 hotfix (no CRD change) to keep window. Then schedule v3.0.0 for next window with migration job.

release-lead: agree. please prepare a values overlay to restore chart version and include release note about deferring CRD migration. We'll also need a temp pin to bypass deploy-bot lock.

oscar: opening PR to cherry-pick hotfix into release overlay: `overlays/gateway/hotfix-v2.3.1.yaml` setting `chart.version: v2.3.1` and `image.tag` bump for small fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/PR-1204

deploy-bot: New commit detected on branch `hotfix-rollback-1204`. Creating locked promotion candidate `hotfix-gateway-1204`. To continue promotion add annotation `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: \"hotfix-1204\"` or run `/deploy override hotfix-1204` by @release-lead.

release-lead: running `/deploy override hotfix-1204` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-lead. Promotion resumed with chart pinned to v2.3.1. Starting canary (5%) in eu-west.

tara: running smoke: `smoke/gateway --checks=health,reconciliation`

(smoke output)
```
2026-08-11T15:02:10Z  health OK
2026-08-11T15:04:22Z  reconciliation OK (CRs stable)
2026-08-11T15:05:01Z  latency P95=110ms
```

mina: smoke green. move to 50%. tracker #DEVOPS-4222 updated.

platform-eng: filing follow-up ticket INFRA-755: implement pre-migration job and add e2e for CRD migrations. Also propose a runbook step: if CRD bump present and window <1h, prefer hotfix pin.

release-lead: adding release notes: \"Deferred CRD migration; pinned chart to v2.3.1 hotfix to avoid irreversible CRD change during brief change window. Migration scheduled for next window with pre-migration job (INFRA-755).\"

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in eu-west. Lockfile `hotfix-1204` closed. CRD-migration candidate remains blocked.

oscar: we'll rehearse the migration in staging with the pre-migration job and re-schedule v3.0.0.

mina: thanks team. I'll update the runbook and tag infra ticket. Thread closed.
